Data.scheme:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: MediationZone Product API with Real-Time Aggregation & SAP SOM
  description: Production REST Router, Aggregation Deduplication & SAP SOM Integration
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: 'http://localhost:8085/v1'
paths:
  /product/search:
    post:
      summary: Product Search with Aggregation Deduplication
      operationId: productSearch
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                transactionId:
                  type: string
                endUserId:
                  type: string
                LOB:
                  type: string
  /product/simulate:
    post:
      summary: Product Plan Simulation via SAP SOM
      operationId: productSimulate
  /product/getOfferList:
    post:
      summary: Get Offer List from SAP HANA DB
      operationId: getOfferList
